products.name: Device Compliance Policies — Commercial
products.short_description: Prove device health and enforce it automatically. Build compliance policies yourself with self-guided, tested steps — far cheaper than consulting.
products.description:
Provable device health, automatically enforced

An unmanaged device with no encryption, a weak PIN, or an outdated OS is a breach waiting to happen — and most organizations have no automated way to prove a device is healthy before it touches company data. Device Compliance Policies define the health rules every device must meet, evaluate them continuously, and feed that status straight into Conditional Access.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant on site to deploy Device Compliance Policies. This package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation that a non-expert administrator can follow from start to finish — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell scripts that do the heavy lifting. You implement with confidence, on your own schedule, and keep the playbook forever.

  • Simpler — exact navigation in the right order, written for a novice admin. Click to implement; the “why” lives in the overview so the steps stay short and uncluttered.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable consulting engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that, with nothing left to bill.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with validation scripts and clear pass/fail gates, so you know it worked before you roll out to the fleet.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how compliance evaluation and enforcement work end to end.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite with how to verify and implement if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered Intune steps: rules, actions for noncompliance, assignment, and Conditional Access pairing.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — health discovery, compliance validation, tenant reporting, safe remediation, and conflict checking.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices.

The Phoenixtekk way

Every Phoenixtekk solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster and more confident with every rollout. Buy once, deploy to unlimited devices, and reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A hard, provable health bar for every device — encryption, Secure Boot, OS, password, and Defender — with automated notify-then-block actions that power Zero Trust access without manual effort.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • DCP-ConflictCheck.ps1 — list compliance policies and their assignments to spot conflicts
    • DCP-Discovery.ps1 — local device health facts for compliance readiness
    • DCP-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation for common compliance failures
    • DCP-TenantReport.ps1 — tenant-wide device compliance status report (Microsoft Graph)
    • DCP-Validation.ps1 — confirm this device meets the compliance baseline and is reporting in

Delivered as a branded Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.
